dialogue.text: Hello, this is Six Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Rob.
dialogue.zh: 你好，這是BBC Learning English的六分鐘英語。我是Rob。
dialogue.ja: こんにちは、BBCラーニングイングリッシュのシックスミニッツイングリッシュです。私はロブです。
dialogue.local: Hello, this is Six Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Rob.
dialogue.en: Hello, this is Six Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Rob.

dialogue.text: And I'm Georgina.
dialogue.zh: 我是Georgina。
dialogue.ja: そして私はジョージナです。
dialogue.local: And I'm Georgina.
dialogue.en: And I'm Georgina.

dialogue.text: Now, Georgina, you recently mentioned in one Six Minute English program about NFTs and that you had a collection of Pokemon cards when you were younger.
dialogue.zh: 現在，Georgina，你最近在一個六分鐘英語節目中提到NFT，還有你年輕時收藏過寶可夢卡片。
dialogue.ja: さて、ジョージナ、あなたは最近のシックスミニッツイングリッシュの番組でNFTについて話し、若い頃にポケモンカードを集めていたと言っていましたね。
dialogue.local: Now, Georgina, you recently mentioned in one Six Minute English program about NFTs and that you had a collection of Pokemon cards when you were younger.
dialogue.en: Now, Georgina, you recently mentioned in one Six Minute English program about NFTs and that you had a collection of Pokemon cards when you were younger.

dialogue.text: Yes, I did, and I still can't find them. Why should you bring that up?
dialogue.zh: 是的，我有收藏，但我還找不到它們。你為什麼要提起這個？
dialogue.ja: はい、持っていましたが、まだ見つかりません。なぜそれを話題にしたのですか？
dialogue.local: Yes, I did, and I still can't find them. Why should you bring that up?
dialogue.en: Yes, I did, and I still can't find them. Why should you bring that up?

dialogue.text: Well, Pokemon started out as a video game series that turned into anime movies and trading cards among other things. And in this program, we're talking about a video game character that is iconic, a word which means widely known and recognized. That character's name is Super Mario.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，寶可夢最初是個電子遊戲系列，後來變成動畫電影和交易卡等。在這個節目中，我們談論一個標誌性的電子遊戲角色，這個詞的意思是廣為人知且被認可。那個角色叫做超級瑪利歐。
dialogue.ja: ポケモンはもともとビデオゲームシリーズとして始まり、アニメ映画やトレーディングカードなどに発展しました。この番組では、象徴的なビデオゲームキャラクターについて話しています。「象徴的」とは広く知られ認識されているという意味です。そのキャラクターの名前はスーパーマリオです。
dialogue.local: Well, Pokemon started out as a video game series that turned into anime movies and trading cards among other things. And in this program, we're talking about a video game character that is iconic, a word which means widely known and recognized. That character's name is Super Mario.
dialogue.en: Well, Pokemon started out as a video game series that turned into anime movies and trading cards among other things. And in this program, we're talking about a video game character that is iconic, a word which means widely known and recognized. That character's name is Super Mario.

dialogue.text: Ah, I spent many hours of my childhood playing with Nintendo Super Mario or his rival Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog.
dialogue.zh: 啊，我童年時花了很多時間玩任天堂的超級瑪利歐或他的對手世嘉的刺猬索尼克。
dialogue.ja: ああ、子供の頃は任天堂のスーパーマリオやライバルのセガのソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグでたくさん遊びました。
dialogue.local: Ah, I spent many hours of my childhood playing with Nintendo Super Mario or his rival Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog.
dialogue.en: Ah, I spent many hours of my childhood playing with Nintendo Super Mario or his rival Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog.

dialogue.text: Now, these days, video games are everywhere, and people of all ages enjoy playing them.
dialogue.zh: 現在，電子遊戲無處不在，各年齡層的人都喜歡玩。
dialogue.ja: 今では、ビデオゲームはどこにでもあり、あらゆる年齢の人々が楽しんでいます。
dialogue.local: Now, these days, video games are everywhere, and people of all ages enjoy playing them.
dialogue.en: Now, these days, video games are everywhere, and people of all ages enjoy playing them.

dialogue.text: There's also competitive e-sports events where gamers compete for what are often considerable amounts of money.
dialogue.zh: 還有競技電競活動，玩家們競爭通常是相當可觀的獎金。
dialogue.ja: また、ゲーマーが多額の賞金をかけて競い合う競技的なeスポーツイベントもあります。
dialogue.local: There's also competitive e-sports events where gamers compete for what are often considerable amounts of money.
dialogue.en: There's also competitive e-sports events where gamers compete for what are often considerable amounts of money.

dialogue.text: Yes, and there are also streamers that appear on platforms like Twitch and YouTube, who have become celebrities in their own right.
dialogue.zh: 是的，還有在Twitch和YouTube等平台上的直播主，他們本身已成為名人。
dialogue.ja: はい、TwitchやYouTubeのようなプラットフォームに登場し、それ自体で有名になったストリーマーもいます。
dialogue.local: Yes, and there are also streamers that appear on platforms like Twitch and YouTube, who have become celebrities in their own right.
dialogue.en: Yes, and there are also streamers that appear on platforms like Twitch and YouTube, who have become celebrities in their own right.

dialogue.text: Talking about celebrities, I have a question about the famous character we're talking about in this program. Many people remember Super Mario brothers as being the first time we saw Mario, but he first appeared in another game, which was it. Was it A, the Legend of Zelda, B, Donkey Kong, or C, Pokemon?
dialogue.zh: 說到名人，我有個問題關於我們這節目中談論的那個著名角色。很多人記得超級瑪利歐兄弟是我們第一次見到瑪利歐，但他其實第一次出現是在另一款遊戲中，是哪一個呢？A是薩爾達傳說，B是大金剛，還是C是寶可夢？
dialogue.ja: 有名なキャラクターの話をしているので、この番組で話しているそのキャラクターについて質問があります。多くの人はスーパーマリオブラザーズがマリオを初めて見た作品だと思っていますが、実は彼は別のゲームで初登場しました。それはどれでしょう？A、ゼルダの伝説、B、ドンキーコング、C、ポケモン？
dialogue.local: Talking about celebrities, I have a question about the famous character we're talking about in this program. Many people remember Super Mario brothers as being the first time we saw Mario, but he first appeared in another game, which was it. Was it A, the Legend of Zelda, B, Donkey Kong, or C, Pokemon?
dialogue.en: Talking about celebrities, I have a question about the famous character we're talking about in this program. Many people remember Super Mario brothers as being the first time we saw Mario, but he first appeared in another game, which was it. Was it A, the Legend of Zelda, B, Donkey Kong, or C, Pokemon?

dialogue.text: I'm not sure about that. I can't remember him being in Pokemon, so I'll go for A, the Legend of Zelda.
dialogue.zh: 我不太確定。我不記得他在寶可夢裡，所以我選A，薩爾達傳說。
dialogue.ja: それはよくわかりません。彼がポケモンにいた記憶はないので、Aのゼルダの伝説にします。
dialogue.local: I'm not sure about that. I can't remember him being in Pokemon, so I'll go for A, the Legend of Zelda.
dialogue.en: I'm not sure about that. I can't remember him being in Pokemon, so I'll go for A, the Legend of Zelda.

dialogue.text: Okay, Georgina, we'll find out if you're right at the end of the program.
dialogue.zh: 好的，Georgina，我們會在節目結尾揭曉你是否答對。
dialogue.ja: わかりました、ジョージナ。番組の最後にあなたが正しいかどうか分かります。
dialogue.local: Okay, Georgina, we'll find out if you're right at the end of the program.
dialogue.en: Okay, Georgina, we'll find out if you're right at the end of the program.

dialogue.text: So, we established at the start of the program that these days, the video games industry is thriving.
dialogue.zh: 所以，我們在節目開始時說過，現在電子遊戲產業正蓬勃發展。
dialogue.ja: それで、番組の最初に、現在のビデオゲーム業界が繁栄していることを確認しました。
dialogue.local: So, we established at the start of the program that these days, the video games industry is thriving.
dialogue.en: So, we established at the start of the program that these days, the video games industry is thriving.

dialogue.text: True, but it wasn't always that way. It's hard to imagine now, but in the 1980s, the console market was struggling, particularly in the US.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但情況並非一直如此。現在很難想像，但在1980年代，主機市場尤其在美國很掙扎。
dialogue.ja: 確かにそうですが、いつもそうだったわけではありません。今では想像しにくいですが、1980年代には特にアメリカでコンソール市場が苦戦していました。
dialogue.local: True, but it wasn't always that way. It's hard to imagine now, but in the 1980s, the console market was struggling, particularly in the US.
dialogue.en: True, but it wasn't always that way. It's hard to imagine now, but in the 1980s, the console market was struggling, particularly in the US.

dialogue.text: Kesar McDonald, video games editor for The Guardian newspaper, explains what was happening in the early 1980s.
dialogue.zh: 《衛報》的電子遊戲編輯Kesar McDonald解釋了1980年代初期發生的情況。
dialogue.ja: ガーディアン紙のビデオゲーム編集者、ケサー・マクドナルドが1980年代初頭に何が起きていたかを説明します。
dialogue.local: Kesar McDonald, video games editor for The Guardian newspaper, explains what was happening in the early 1980s.
dialogue.en: Kesar McDonald, video games editor for The Guardian newspaper, explains what was happening in the early 1980s.

dialogue.text: Here she is on the BBC World Service program, You and Yours, Speaking with Peter White.
dialogue.zh: 她在BBC世界服務節目《你和你的》與Peter White對話。
dialogue.ja: 彼女はBBCワールドサービスの番組『You and Yours』でピーター・ホワイトと話しています。
dialogue.local: Here she is on the BBC World Service program, You and Yours, Speaking with Peter White.
dialogue.en: Here she is on the BBC World Service program, You and Yours, Speaking with Peter White.

dialogue.text: Well, back then, especially in America, there had been a flood of games that were just not very high quality. One of the games that often cited as a factor in the collapse was this game called ET on the Atari, which was so bad that they ended up burying thousands of copies of it in the desert because nobody's out there.
dialogue.zh: 當時，特別是在美國，有大量品質不佳的遊戲。常被提及為市場崩潰原因之一的遊戲是Atari的ET，爛到最後他們把數千份遊戲埋在沙漠裡，因為沒有人會去玩。
dialogue.ja: 当時、特にアメリカでは、質の低いゲームが大量に出回っていました。市場崩壊の要因としてよく挙げられるゲームの一つがアタリのETで、あまりに酷かったため、何千本ものコピーを砂漠に埋めたほどです。誰もそこに行かないからです。
dialogue.local: Well, back then, especially in America, there had been a flood of games that were just not very high quality. One of the games that often cited as a factor in the collapse was this game called ET on the Atari, which was so bad that they ended up burying thousands of copies of it in the desert because nobody's out there.
dialogue.en: Well, back then, especially in America, there had been a flood of games that were just not very high quality. One of the games that often cited as a factor in the collapse was this game called ET on the Atari, which was so bad that they ended up burying thousands of copies of it in the desert because nobody's out there.

dialogue.text: So we'd had, especially in America, this didn't happen so much in Europe, but in America, there'd just been lots and lots of software. None of it was all that great. There hadn't been anything really revolutionary in some years, so the video game boom was really falling off the cliff and Nintendo is what rescued it in the US, especially.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們看到，特別是在美國，這種情況在歐洲不太發生，但美國有大量軟體推出，品質都不怎麼樣。多年來沒有真正革命性的作品，電子遊戲熱潮真的崩潰了，而任天堂特別在美國救了這個市場。
dialogue.ja: ですから、特にアメリカでは、ヨーロッパほどではありませんが、多くのソフトが出回りました。しかしどれもあまり良くありませんでした。数年間、革新的なものはなく、ビデオゲームブームは崖から落ちるように衰退し、特にアメリカでは任天堂がそれを救いました。
dialogue.local: So we'd had, especially in America, this didn't happen so much in Europe, but in America, there'd just been lots and lots of software. None of it was all that great. There hadn't been anything really revolutionary in some years, so the video game boom was really falling off the cliff and Nintendo is what rescued it in the US, especially.
dialogue.en: So we'd had, especially in America, this didn't happen so much in Europe, but in America, there'd just been lots and lots of software. None of it was all that great. There hadn't been anything really revolutionary in some years, so the video game boom was really falling off the cliff and Nintendo is what rescued it in the US, especially.

dialogue.text: Kesar McDonald used the term a flood of, meaning a large number in a short period of time to describe the number of games that were coming out.
dialogue.zh: Kesar McDonald用了「a flood of」這個詞，意思是在短時間內大量湧現，用來形容當時大量推出的遊戲。
dialogue.ja: ケサー・マクドナルドは「a flood of」という表現を使い、短期間に大量のゲームが出たことを意味しています。
dialogue.local: Kesar McDonald used the term a flood of, meaning a large number in a short period of time to describe the number of games that were coming out.
dialogue.en: Kesar McDonald used the term a flood of, meaning a large number in a short period of time to describe the number of games that were coming out.

dialogue.text: She used sighted, which means referenced or noted, when talking about the game ET being a reference for a factor in the collapse of the console market.
dialogue.zh: 她用sighted這個詞，意思是被提及或注意到，指ET遊戲被視為主機市場崩潰的原因之一。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は「sighted」という言葉を使いました。これは参照された、または指摘されたという意味で、ETというゲームがコンソール市場崩壊の要因として挙げられたことを指します。
dialogue.local: She used sighted, which means referenced or noted, when talking about the game ET being a reference for a factor in the collapse of the console market.
dialogue.en: She used sighted, which means referenced or noted, when talking about the game ET being a reference for a factor in the collapse of the console market.

dialogue.text: And she said, boom, a sudden period of growth. So as ET was mentioned, as a factor in the collapse, many people say that Super Mario Brothers was the reason that video games really took off, especially in the US.
dialogue.zh: 她說boom是指突然的成長期。既然ET被提及為崩潰原因，很多人說超級瑪利歐兄弟是電子遊戲真正起飛的原因，特別是在美國。
dialogue.ja: そして彼女は「boom」と言いました。これは急激な成長期を意味します。ETが崩壊の要因として言及されたので、多くの人はスーパーマリオブラザーズがビデオゲームを本当に盛り上げた理由だと言います。特にアメリカで。
dialogue.local: And she said, boom, a sudden period of growth. So as ET was mentioned, as a factor in the collapse, many people say that Super Mario Brothers was the reason that video games really took off, especially in the US.
dialogue.en: And she said, boom, a sudden period of growth. So as ET was mentioned, as a factor in the collapse, many people say that Super Mario Brothers was the reason that video games really took off, especially in the US.

dialogue.text: Hmm, it's interesting to consider what might have been, if its creator, Shigeru Miyamoto had never created that character. The question is, why is that game so popular? What made it so fun to play?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，如果創作者宮本茂從未創造那個角色，會是怎樣呢？有趣的是，為什麼那款遊戲如此受歡迎？是什麼讓它玩起來這麼有趣？
dialogue.ja: もしそのキャラクターを作った宮本茂がいなかったらどうなっていたか考えるのは興味深いですね。問題は、なぜそのゲームがそんなに人気なのか？何がそれを楽しくしているのか？です。
dialogue.local: Hmm, it's interesting to consider what might have been, if its creator, Shigeru Miyamoto had never created that character. The question is, why is that game so popular? What made it so fun to play?
dialogue.en: Hmm, it's interesting to consider what might have been, if its creator, Shigeru Miyamoto had never created that character. The question is, why is that game so popular? What made it so fun to play?

dialogue.text: Here is Kesar McDonald speaking again with Peter White on the BBC World Service Program You and Yours, explaining why Mario is just so popular and what makes the original game so satisfying to play.
dialogue.zh: 這是Kesar McDonald在BBC世界服務節目《你和你的》中再次與Peter White對話，解釋為什麼瑪利歐如此受歡迎，以及原版遊戲為何如此令人滿足。
dialogue.ja: こちらはケサー・マクドナルドがBBCワールドサービスの『You and Yours』でピーター・ホワイトと話し、なぜマリオがそんなに人気なのか、そしてオリジナルゲームがなぜ満足感を与えるのかを説明しています。
dialogue.local: Here is Kesar McDonald speaking again with Peter White on the BBC World Service Program You and Yours, explaining why Mario is just so popular and what makes the original game so satisfying to play.
dialogue.en: Here is Kesar McDonald speaking again with Peter White on the BBC World Service Program You and Yours, explaining why Mario is just so popular and what makes the original game so satisfying to play.

dialogue.text: It's just such a joy to play. It's running and jumping and it's the joy of movement.
dialogue.zh: 玩起來非常愉快。跑跳動作帶來了運動的樂趣。
dialogue.ja: 遊ぶのがとても楽しいんです。走ったりジャンプしたり、動く喜びがあります。
dialogue.local: It's just such a joy to play. It's running and jumping and it's the joy of movement.
dialogue.en: It's just such a joy to play. It's running and jumping and it's the joy of movement.

dialogue.text: When you play, even the original Super Mario Brothers, you just feel the sense of joy in your movement. And it's one of the greatest games I've ever made.
dialogue.zh: 當你玩原版超級瑪利歐兄弟時，你會感受到動作帶來的喜悅。這是我做過最棒的遊戲之一。
dialogue.ja: オリジナルのスーパーマリオブラザーズをプレイすると、動きの中に喜びを感じます。これは私が作った中で最高のゲームの一つです。
dialogue.local: When you play, even the original Super Mario Brothers, you just feel the sense of joy in your movement. And it's one of the greatest games I've ever made.
dialogue.en: When you play, even the original Super Mario Brothers, you just feel the sense of joy in your movement. And it's one of the greatest games I've ever made.

dialogue.text: And a lot of games from 35 years ago are basically unplayable now. They might have been a step to something greater, but Mario is one of those few that really holds up today as well that did them.
dialogue.zh: 很多35年前的遊戲現在基本上無法玩了。它們可能是通往更偉大作品的階梯，但瑪利歐是少數至今仍然耐玩的遊戲之一。
dialogue.ja: 35年前の多くのゲームは今ではほとんど遊べません。より良いものへのステップだったかもしれませんが、マリオは今でもしっかりと通用する数少ないゲームの一つです。
dialogue.local: And a lot of games from 35 years ago are basically unplayable now. They might have been a step to something greater, but Mario is one of those few that really holds up today as well that did them.
dialogue.en: And a lot of games from 35 years ago are basically unplayable now. They might have been a step to something greater, but Mario is one of those few that really holds up today as well that did them.

dialogue.text: Kesar McDonald said that some games from 35 years ago are unplayable, so not possible to play them.
dialogue.zh: Kesar McDonald說有些35年前的遊戲無法玩，也就是無法進行遊戲。
dialogue.ja: ケサー・マクドナルドは、35年前のゲームの中には遊べないものもあると言いました。
dialogue.local: Kesar McDonald said that some games from 35 years ago are unplayable, so not possible to play them.
dialogue.en: Kesar McDonald said that some games from 35 years ago are unplayable, so not possible to play them.

dialogue.text: But she said that Mario holds up. A term used to say that something standards or quality has not lessened.
dialogue.zh: 但她說瑪利歐依然耐玩。這個詞用來表示某物的標準或品質沒有降低。
dialogue.ja: しかし彼女はマリオは今でも通用すると言いました。「holds up」は品質や基準が落ちていないことを意味します。
dialogue.local: But she said that Mario holds up. A term used to say that something standards or quality has not lessened.
dialogue.en: But she said that Mario holds up. A term used to say that something standards or quality has not lessened.

dialogue.text: It certainly does hold up. In fact, I played it the other day and I had lots of fun with it. It reminded me of my childhood and it's still as good now as it was then.
dialogue.zh: 它確實依然耐玩。事實上，我前幾天玩了它，玩得很開心。它讓我想起童年，現在玩起來和當年一樣好。
dialogue.ja: 確かに今でも通用します。実は先日プレイしてとても楽しかったです。子供の頃を思い出させてくれて、今でも昔と同じくらい良いゲームです。
dialogue.local: It certainly does hold up. In fact, I played it the other day and I had lots of fun with it. It reminded me of my childhood and it's still as good now as it was then.
dialogue.en: It certainly does hold up. In fact, I played it the other day and I had lots of fun with it. It reminded me of my childhood and it's still as good now as it was then.

dialogue.text: Which reminds me of your quiz question, Rob.
dialogue.zh: 這讓我想起你的測驗問題，Rob。
dialogue.ja: それで、ロブのクイズの質問を思い出しました。
dialogue.local: Which reminds me of your quiz question, Rob.
dialogue.en: Which reminds me of your quiz question, Rob.

dialogue.text: Yes, in my quiz question, I asked Georgina which game had the first appearance of that famous plumber, Mario?
dialogue.zh: 是的，在我的測驗問題中，我問Georgina哪款遊戲是那位著名水管工瑪利歐的首次登場？
dialogue.ja: はい、クイズでジョージナにあの有名な配管工マリオが初登場したゲームはどれか尋ねました。
dialogue.local: Yes, in my quiz question, I asked Georgina which game had the first appearance of that famous plumber, Mario?
dialogue.en: Yes, in my quiz question, I asked Georgina which game had the first appearance of that famous plumber, Mario?

dialogue.text: I went for A, the Legend of Zelda.
dialogue.zh: 我選了A，薩爾達傳說。
dialogue.ja: 私はAのゼルダの伝説にしました。
dialogue.local: I went for A, the Legend of Zelda.
dialogue.en: I went for A, the Legend of Zelda.

dialogue.text: Ah, which is wrong. I'm afraid. Mario's first appearance was in Donkey Kong. And his creator, Shigeru Miyamoto, never thought he would be that popular.
dialogue.zh: 啊，那是錯的。瑪利歐的首次登場是在大金剛。他的創作者宮本茂從沒想過他會那麼受歡迎。
dialogue.ja: ああ、それは間違いです。マリオの初登場はドンキーコングでした。彼の創作者、宮本茂は彼がそんなに人気になるとは思っていませんでした。
dialogue.local: Ah, which is wrong. I'm afraid. Mario's first appearance was in Donkey Kong. And his creator, Shigeru Miyamoto, never thought he would be that popular.
dialogue.en: Ah, which is wrong. I'm afraid. Mario's first appearance was in Donkey Kong. And his creator, Shigeru Miyamoto, never thought he would be that popular.

dialogue.text: Well, I guess we've already learnt something today. Let's recap the vocabulary from today's programme about Super Mario, starting with iconic, famously associated with something and instantly recognisable.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我想我們今天已經學到一些東西了。讓我們回顧今天節目中關於超級瑪利歐的詞彙，從iconic開始，意指與某物著名相關且立刻被認出。
dialogue.ja: さて、今日は何か学べたと思います。スーパーマリオに関する今日の番組の語彙を復習しましょう。まずは「iconic」、何かと有名に結びつき、すぐに認識できることです。
dialogue.local: Well, I guess we've already learnt something today. Let's recap the vocabulary from today's programme about Super Mario, starting with iconic, famously associated with something and instantly recognisable.
dialogue.en: Well, I guess we've already learnt something today. Let's recap the vocabulary from today's programme about Super Mario, starting with iconic, famously associated with something and instantly recognisable.

dialogue.text: Then we had a flood of, which means a large amount of something in a short space of time.
dialogue.zh: 接著是a flood of，意思是在短時間內大量的某物。
dialogue.ja: 次に「a flood of」、短期間に大量の何かを意味します。
dialogue.local: Then we had a flood of, which means a large amount of something in a short space of time.
dialogue.en: Then we had a flood of, which means a large amount of something in a short space of time.

dialogue.text: Sighted means referenced or noted.
dialogue.zh: Sighted意思是被提及或注意到。
dialogue.ja: 「Sighted」は参照された、または指摘されたという意味です。
dialogue.local: Sighted means referenced or noted.
dialogue.en: Sighted means referenced or noted.

dialogue.text: Boom relates to explosion and means a short period of sudden growth.
dialogue.zh: Boom與爆炸有關，意思是短時間內的突然成長。
dialogue.ja: 「Boom」は爆発に関連し、急激な成長の短期間を意味します。
dialogue.local: Boom relates to explosion and means a short period of sudden growth.
dialogue.en: Boom relates to explosion and means a short period of sudden growth.

dialogue.text: Unplayable describes something that can't be played or a game that is very difficult to enjoy.
dialogue.zh: Unplayable形容無法玩的東西，或是很難享受的遊戲。
dialogue.ja: 「Unplayable」は遊べないもの、または楽しむのが非常に難しいゲームを表します。
dialogue.local: Unplayable describes something that can't be played or a game that is very difficult to enjoy.
dialogue.en: Unplayable describes something that can't be played or a game that is very difficult to enjoy.

dialogue.text: And finally holds up means that the quality or standard of something hasn't changed, and still looks good or plays well.
dialogue.zh: 最後，holds up表示某物的品質或標準沒有改變，仍然看起來很好或玩起來很棒。
dialogue.ja: 最後に「holds up」は、何かの品質や基準が変わっておらず、今でも良い状態であることを意味します。
dialogue.local: And finally holds up means that the quality or standard of something hasn't changed, and still looks good or plays well.
dialogue.en: And finally holds up means that the quality or standard of something hasn't changed, and still looks good or plays well.

dialogue.text: That's all for this programme.
dialogue.zh: 本節目到此結束。
dialogue.ja: これでこの番組は終わりです。
dialogue.local: That's all for this programme.
dialogue.en: That's all for this programme.

dialogue.text: Bye for now. Bye.
dialogue.zh: 暫時再見，再見。
dialogue.ja: それでは、また。さようなら。
dialogue.local: Bye for now. Bye.
dialogue.en: Bye for now. Bye.
